stem.text: A wire is fixed at one end and extended by a force that is applied to the other end. The force is slowly increased from zero and then slowly decreased back to zero.
The force–extension graph for the wire is shown.

stem.alt: Graph with vertical axis force and horizontal axis extension, origin marked 0; a curve with arrows on the line.

stem.text: The graph line for the wire being loaded is the same as the graph line for the wire being unloaded.
Which statement describes the deformation of the wire?

A.text: It is both elastic and plastic.

C.text: It is neither elastic nor plastic.
